decisions.reason: Although an accelerator is outside the firm's core machinery business, its continued homepage prominence suggests management values it as a channel to absorb external green-technology knowledge and partnerships, so it is more likely to be retained than discontinued.

A bio-based bitumen binder depends more on materials and chemical capabilities than on the firm's established machinery know-how, so under an absorptive-capacity logic it is harder for the firm to interpret results and improve it internally, making discontinuation more likely.

The infectious waste decontamination plant fits the firm's engineering and plant-integration knowledge base, has remained prominently featured across both years, and appears to benefit from cooperation-based learning, so management would likely keep it on the market.
